title: Florida House, District 36
what_it_does: Represents District 36 (Part of Seminole) in the Florida House; votes on state laws and the state budget.
verified_ballot_note: Candidate list taken from the Florida Division of Elections, 2026 general election candidate list on 2026-09-18 (https://dos.elections.myflorida.com/candidates/CanList.asp); statuses Qualified/Unopposed only. Counties from the Legislature's district listings. Positions have not been researched yet.

candidates.name: Rachel Plakon
candidates.photo_source: Ballotpedia candidate photo (downloaded copy in assets/photos)
candidates.occupation: Real estate investment company and brokerage owner; state representative (first elected 2022)
candidates.background: Plakon, of Lake Mary, owns a real estate investment company and brokerage and previously worked as a commercial land specialist. She holds an MBA from Florida International University, served on the Florida Commission on the Status of Women and was elected to the House in 2022.

roster_sources.title: Florida Division of Elections, 2026 general election candidate list

property_tax.summary: Voted for HJR 203 (Feb. 19, 2026), which would phase out all non-school property taxes on homesteads, and for HJR 1F (June 2, 2026), which placed the Amendment 3 homestead-exemption increase on the November ballot.

sources.title: Floor Vote for CS/CS/HJR 203, Elimination of Non-school Property Taxes for Homesteads, Florida House
Floor Vote for CS/HJR 1F, Save Our Homes from Excessive Property Taxes (2026 special session), Florida House
2026 Voter's Guide - Florida House District 36, Republican primary (ClickOrlando / News 6)

taxes.summary: Her site calls her a champion for lower taxes and cites record $4.2 billion in tax cuts.
taxes.quote: record tax cuts of $4.2 billion dollars

sources.title: Rachel Plakon for Florida House (campaign site)

education_choice.summary: Voted for HB 1 (2023), which opened Florida's private-school scholarship (voucher) programs to every K-12 student regardless of family income. Her site lists support for school choice.

sources.title: Floor Vote for CS/CS/CS/CS/HB 1, Education (universal school choice), Florida House
Rachel Plakon for Florida House (campaign site)

immigration.summary: Voted for SB 2-C in the February 2025 special session, which created a State Board of Immigration Enforcement, required state and local cooperation with federal immigration enforcement and added state penalties for people in the country illegally. She also sponsored HB 1589 aimed at illegal immigration.
immigration.quote: help stop illegal immigration into Florida

sources.title: Floor Vote for SB 2-C, Immigration (2025 special session), Florida House
Rachel Plakon for Florida House (campaign site)

abortion.summary: Voted for SB 300 (2023), the Heartbeat Protection Act, which bans most abortions after six weeks of pregnancy.

sources.title: Floor Vote for SB 300, Pregnancy and Parenting Support (Heartbeat Protection Act), Florida House

guns.summary: Voted for HB 543 (2023), which allowed carrying a concealed firearm without a license, and for HB 759 (2025) and HB 133 (2026), which would lower the minimum age to buy a rifle or shotgun from 21 to 18.

sources.title: Floor Vote for CS/HB 543, Public Safety (permitless concealed carry), Florida House

crime.summary: Cites HB 365 to hold drug dealers accountable and a ban on tianeptine, and pledges to maintain law and order.

candidates.name: Darryl Block
candidates.background: Block, 45, of Sanford, holds social work degrees from USF and Florida State and a law degree from Barry University. He describes himself as a working parent of a child with disabilities and a product of public schools.
